title: GLM-5.3-Flash CSF with SparkCache CRC32 on 2 Sparks (research-only)
evidence_scope: Research-only; no build, CUDA restore, serving or performance evidence exists for this composition. The installer variant preserves the settings of glm53-flash-nvfp4-sparkcache-tp2, adds explicit fast CRC32 payload integrity and a separate rank-local cache root, and requires the development image produced by runtime/images/compositions/installer-sparkcache-8abbe9da67b8. That layer pins SparkCache 8abbe9da67b8143831d21b43d0395c4f347a619a over release 2026.10.4. Historical results for glm53-flash-nvfp4-sparkcache-tp2 do not qualify this variant. The recorded checkpoint identity 6af0343976eefbfa0fb59d87befcf6d10f02fef90ba0e7881dd1201fe0ecd76e is retained; its original derivation is not available.
